deliberate_differences: 1007804's FP8 drafter context (both roles) is the GEN drafter's class constant draft_kv_dtype = torch.float8_e4m3fn: the engine (KvCacheCreator._get_draft_kv_model_config) builds the appended draft layers in FP8 E4M3 for a drafter that declares it, the context servers' family drafter (tp1 target) declares the same, and the transfer handshake rejects peers whose draft-layer dtypes differ (served: _get_unified_draft_cache_kwargs set draft_dtype from a speculative_config setting both servers carried).

Draft cache = #21996's unified draft cache (draft layers appended to the target's V2 manager as KVCacheLayerSpec(owner=DRAFT), global ids 93..97, transfer ids 2*(93+d) = 186..194) instead of served's CacheDomain + get_draft_block_table: same layers, pages, page size 128 and Helix split (global page g on CP rank g % 16), same bytes (FP8: 576 B/token/layer, 73,728 B/page/layer).

KDA checkpoint mode is a K3UllKdaCheckpointState subclass of #21996's KDAReplayState (served: checkpoint branches inside KDAReplayState); the per-slot layout, header (256 B), flat-view row stride U and the seed / commit points are served's.
checkpoint_position_rows is computed once at bind (served: inside every checkpoint_indices call), so the step's index build launches fewer kernels; same indices.
The accepted-count buffer is declared 256 B per slot (served 16 B) so the coalesced slot stride stays a multiple of the largest flat-view row stride; capacity only (240 B per slot).

Served env switches of the zone are constants at 1007804's values: TRTLLM_KDA_BATCHED_REPLAY_SEED, TRTLLM_KDA_MIDCHUNK_SNAPSHOT (CTX only, off), TRTLLM_STATE_INDEX_COPY_KERNEL (1007804: =1 (1007804's GEN srun --export; the case's trtllm_config.yaml lacks it); not wired here: #21996's two DeviceCopyBuffer uploads, which like served's kernel write nothing while the indices are unchanged), TRTLLM_DISAGG_GEN_FAST_SYNC (1007804: =1; off under CP16), TRTLLM_BOUND_UCX_CUDA_IPC_CACHE (off). Sharing the draft KV between the servers is decided by declaration (the drafter reads the manager's pages, the manager accepts appended draft layers), not by served's deployment env switch.
